proves.claim: While one seat holds an item's review lease, a second waits on the lease and is then refused REVIEW_HELD with zero calls to the board write it wraps.

cli.io-next-review-lease.second-seat-ref.why: Without it, every idle seat queues on the board's one write lock to reserve the same review and the losers fail only after getting the lock.

proves.claim: A review lease whose pid is gone is reclaimed at once and the write runs.

cli.io-next-review-lease.dead-holder-rec.why: Without it, a seat killed mid-reservation would block every other seat's reservation of that review until the lease ran out.

proves.claim: A reservation write that fails leaves no lease file, so the next seat reserves at once.

cli.io-next-review-lease.failed-write-fr.why: Without it, one failed write would hold the lease and turn the next seats away with REVIEW_HELD for a review nobody took.

proves.claim: 12 pullboard next calls started together in process on one board with one submitted review and 12 open builds each end with a distinct item, one of them the review, and none BOARD_BUSY or NEXT_TIMEOUT.

cli.journeys-next-herd.twelve-seats-dist.why: Without it, a herd of seats calling next at once could collide on the one board writer and hand two seats the same item or none.

proves.claim: A seat that only runs next, next --done and next --stuck ends with the first item submitted, the second open with a BLOCKED release carrying the reason, and one next command per instruction.

cli.journeys-next-loop.two-items-one-voi.why: Without it an agent loop of only next, next --done and next --stuck could break unnoticed.

proves.claim: Across that loop no instruction or shout the seat reads tells it to release an item it holds.

cli.journeys-next-loop.never-told-to-rel.why: Without it an agent loop of only next, next --done and next --stuck could break unnoticed.
